title: Owl Ring Recoveries
description: Ring recoveries are an essential component in the EcoSolutions Owl Box Project and owl rehabilitation. Young owlets who fledge from our owl boxes are destined to go on and become "owl box breeding owls".
html:
View Gallery

Ringing and ring recoveries are an essential part of our release programme. Ring recovery information is important to our understanding of release procedure success and additionally, provides data on fledging distances and survival rates. If you do come across a dead owl in the Gauteng area with a metal Safring, please contact us. Without sounding too macabre, we would love to have a look at it.

In this gallery are ring recoveries from owls that were released through the EcoSolutions release programme.
